scientific.integrity: The result is an exact algebraic consequence of Eve's defining stabilized objective-feedback equation. A constant multiplicative objective-gap ratio makes the clipped feedback constant, so the smoothing recurrence is solved exactly.
limitations: Objective-feedback input-response result rather than a full parameter-dynamics theorem.
Requires known global minimum and strictly positive observed objective gaps.
Geometric traces are a diagnostic family; stochastic training need not follow them.
No application-specific harm claim is made from the reciprocal symmetry alone.

title: Eve's stabilized feedback is exactly reciprocal-symmetric in objective-gap ratios
